identificationModule.officialTitle: Clinical Study of CD19 Targeting Chimeric Antigen Receptor T Lymphocytes (CAR-T) in the Treatment of Refractory Autoimmune Diseases

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: the CD19 targeted CAR-T cell therapies have gained significant results in patients with relapsed and refractory B-cell Leukemia and Lymphoma. Otherwise, some studies have shown that the use of CD19-targeted CAR-T therapy in refractory SLE can improve the autoimmune symptoms of patients, and at the same time, immunosuppressants and hormones can be stopped to maintain long-term autoimmune indicators normal.To verify the safety and efficacy, the investigators launch such a clinical trial using CD19 targeted CAR-T cells for patients with Refractory Autoimmune Disease.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence of Adverse events after CD19 CAR-T cells infusion [Safety and Tolerability]
primaryOutcomes.description: Therapy-related adverse events were recorded and assessed according to the National Cancer Institute's Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE, Version 5.0)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Obtain the maximum tolerated dose of CD19 CAR-T cells[Safety and Tolerability]
Efficacy of CAR-T cell preparations in Refractory systemic lupus erythematosus [Effectiveness]
primaryOutcomes.description:
The efficacy is assessed by SRI-4 response rate at 3M，SRI-4 response rate at 3M means Percentage of patients who met all three of the following conditions at 3M after refusion:

1. The SLEDAI-2K rating dropped by at least 4 points
2. No deterioration in PGA scores on a 3-point scale (deterioration is defined as an increase of ≥0.3 points from baseline score)
3. No new manifestations of organ system involvement (new system involvement is defined as one or more new symptoms of BILAG grade A or two or more symptoms of BILAG B)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Efficacy of CAR-T cell preparations in Refractory Systemic scleroderma [Effectiveness]
primaryOutcomes.description: The efficacy is assessed by Change value of The EULAR Sjögren's syndrome disease activity index（ESSDAI）score at 3M

primaryOutcomes.measure: Efficacy of CAR-T cell preparations in Refractory Sjogren's syndrome [Effectiveness]
primaryOutcomes.description: The efficacy is assessed by Change value of modified Rondan skin score（mRSS） at 3M； The evaluator palpated 17 areas of the patient's body. The skin thickness of each area was calculated on a scale of 0 to 3 points. The total score was 51 points, 0 was normal skin with fine lines and no skin thickening. 1 is divided into mild skin thickening, the inspector can easily use two fingers to pinch the skin to form wrinkles, skin fine lines can also exist; 2: moderate skin thickening, more difficult to pinch the skin to form wrinkles, skin fine lines disappear; 3 is classified as severe skin thickening, unable to pinch the skin to form wrinkles.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Efficacy of CAR-T cell preparations in Refractory dermatomyositis [Effectiveness]
primaryOutcomes.description: The efficacy is assessed by CSM Total Improvement Score (TIS) 20/40/60 improvement rate at 3M；3M CSM Total Improvement Score (TIS) 20/40/60 Improvement rate: defined as the proportion of patients with a TIS score of 20-40,40-60, and ≥60 at 3M posttransfusion

primaryOutcomes.measure: Efficacy of CAR-T cell preparations in Refractory The antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody-associated vasculitides [Effectiveness]
primaryOutcomes.description: The efficacy is assessed by response rate at 3M； Defined as the percentage of patients whose BVAS score decreased to 0 at 3M after reinfusion in the absence of glucocorticoids and other therapeutic agents

secondaryOutcomes.measure: AUCS of CD19 CAR-T cells [Cell dynamics]
secondaryOutcomes.description: AUCS is defined as the area under the curve in 90 days

secondaryOutcomes.measure: CMAX of CD19 CAR-T cells [Cell dynamics]
secondaryOutcomes.description: CMAX is defined as the highest concentration of CD70 CAR-T cells expanded in peripheral blood

secondaryOutcomes.measure: TMAX of CD19 CAR-T cells[Cell dynamics]
secondaryOutcomes.description: TMAX is defined as the time to reach the highest concentration

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Pharmacodynamics of CD19 CAR-T cells[Cell dynamics]
secondaryOutcomes.description: Pharmacodynamics is defined as the degree of B cell clearance at each time point

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Immunogenicity after infusion of CD19 CAR-T
secondaryOutcomes.description: Positive rate of anti-CAR antibody in peripheral blood

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Immunological reconstitution of CAR-T after infusion of CD19 CAR-T
secondaryOutcomes.description: The change curve of B cells in peripheral blood after transfusion;

otherOutcomes.measure: Refractory systemic lupus erythematosus -specific secondary study endpoint [Effectiveness]
otherOutcomes.description: SLEDAI-2K change curve within 2 years after the transfusion or subjects withdrew from the study for various reasons (whichever happened first);

otherOutcomes.measure: Refractory Systemic scleroderma-specific secondary study endpoint [Effectiveness]
otherOutcomes.description: ESSDAI change curve within 2 years after transfusion or subjects withdrew from the study for various reasons (whichever happened first); ESSPRI change curve;

otherOutcomes.measure: Refractory Sjogren's syndrome-specific secondary study endpoint [Effectiveness]
otherOutcomes.description: DLCO change curve within 2 years after transfusion or subjects withdrew from the study for various reasons (whichever happened first);
3M CDASI score changes (Appendix 14); CDASI score change curve within 2 years after transfusion or subjects withdrew from the study for various reasons (whichever happened first);

otherOutcomes.measure: Refractory The antineutrophil cytoplasmic antibody-associated vasculitides -specific secondary study endpoint [Effectiveness]
otherOutcomes.description: BVAS score within 2 years after retransfusion or when subjects withdrew from the study for various reasons (whichever occurred first).
